annotations.title: How one job posting compares with the market

description: For the employer of one open US healthcare, finance, IT, engineering, science, HR, legal, marketing, sales, customer service, admin, operations and logistics, skilled trades, retail and food, or education posting (nurses, therapists, pharmacists, accountants, financial analysts, bankers, software engineers, data and security roles, engineers, scientists, attorneys, paralegals, recruiters, HR and marketing roles): free, the posted pay range for the role within 25 miles and how many employers are hiring it, competitors counted, not named. How fast roles like it close, where this posting's pay and time open sit against each competitor by name, how hard the role is to fill there and what reaching more applicants costs are in the Competitive Hiring Report (request_competitive_hiring_report; first report free). Identify the posting by its careers-site URL, a VeritaHire job id, or employer and title (and city, state). A posting not yet analysed returns status "building" with market_now (the role's market within 25 miles, counted that moment) and retry_after_seconds for the full summary. A posting we do not hold, named by title and city/state, returns status "not_held" with the same market_now and a link for a report on the role as planned.
